span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Sensorimotor activation during comprehension arises from integrating linguistic information with non-linguistic information held in modality-specific cortices, and that integration requires conscious access, so subliminal words stay confined to segregated linguistic networks.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Without awareness, processing remains restricted to specialised, segregated neural networks, which is why distant sensorimotor and association areas are not recruited.

span.label: **A NULL WITH ITS OWN POSITIVE CONTROL, IN THE SAME APPARATUS:** `when symbolic and nonsemantic mechanisms were prevented, allowing only for a genuinely EMBODIED semantic priming, NO EFFECT WAS FOUND. Conversely, FACILITATION EMERGED IN THE SAME EXPERIMENTAL PARADIGM when embodied priming was prevented and symbolic priming was allowed.` **Six experiments, and the machine works when you leave the other route open.** A failed manipulation cannot selectively succeed - which is the objection every unconscious-priming null has to answer, and this one answers it by construction rather than by argument. Same structure as hesselmann2016 (Q-818) at three times the scale
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE LEVEL CLAIM IS EXACT:** `Quotation withheld.` **Unconscious words reach meaning and stop before simulation.** The `although` is the whole value: this is not a claim that unconscious processing is shallow - the words got to semantics - but that the chain BREAKS at a specific link. A corpus of masked-priming records mostly argues about whether meaning was reached at all; this one grants that and asks what comes after
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE CONCLUSION IS OFFERED AS A CONDITION, NOT A MECHANISM:** `Quotation withheld.` `might need` is inside the quote. **What makes this more than a hedge is that it is falsifiable in an obvious way** - show sensorimotor activation from an unconscious word under any conditions and it is gone - and the authors have just spent six experiments failing to do that themselves
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND IT SITS AGAINST dehaene1998 IN THIS CORPUS, WITHOUT CONTRADICTING IT.** dehaene1998 concluded that an unreportable numeral was `unconsciously processed according to task instructions, ALL THE WAY DOWN TO THE MOTOR SYSTEM`. This paper finds no sensorimotor activation from unconscious words at all. **Both can be right, because `reaches the motor system` names two things:** dehaene1998's is a TRAINED RESPONSE MAPPING - a digit compared to 5, a hand prepared, an arbitrary rule applied - and Bottini's is SIMULATION OF MEANING, the claim that understanding `up` re-enacts upward experience. An unconscious stimulus can drive the first and fail the second. **Same shape as Q-821's two senses of `nonconscious`, and the corpus currently indexes both pairs under one heading**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: With a 33 ms prime, the congruency effect vanished as soon as primes and targets were drawn from separate word sets, showing the priming in the replication experiment came from short-term stimulus-response associations rather than from meaning.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Raising the prime display from 33 ms to 50 ms produced a reliable, genuinely semantic priming effect with non-overlapping prime and target sets while the primes stayed subliminal.
span.note: retracted: RE-GROUNDED - THE POINTER WAS WRONG, NOT THE CLAIM. The old evidence was verbatim, anchored and correctly cut, and it contained NONE of this claim's numbers (33, 50). The paper states the claim in one sentence elsewhere and the tagger did not use it. CLAUDE_B, 2026-08-23: `WE HAVE SPENT THE DAY VERIFYING THAT QUOTES ARE REAL AND NONE OF IT ASKS WHETHER THEY ARE RELEVANT.` Confirmed by reading the claim, the old span and the candidate together; the candidate carries every number AND the claim's own content words.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Priming still appeared when spatial primes were paired with wholly unrelated transport-word targets, which rules out spreading activation between related meanings as the source of the effect.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: When the task made the response mapping non-spatial so that only embodied priming could operate, no priming appeared at all — neither facilitation nor inhibition.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In the identical paradigm with gender primes and gender symbols, where embodiment was impossible but evidence accumulation was possible, facilitatory priming reappeared.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The pattern gives a case where unconscious words are processed semantically yet activate no sensorimotor representation, so motor activation is not an automatic or necessary part of semantic processing.
